neighbours.label: 'the/The' introducing an institution or organisation in expository news or business prose (vs. 'the' in narrative fiction on the + pole)
fire: Revenue grew by ten percent in 2019. The firm now has offices in six cities.
After the merger, the agency expanded its services to rural areas.
Since its launch, the platform has attracted two million users.
Following the audit, the council approved a new budget.
Over the past decade, the network has added forty stations.
In response to demand, the university opened a second campus.
Earlier this year, the foundation awarded grants to ten schools.
With new funding, the hospital will hire more nurses next year.
quiet: Revenue grew by ten percent in 2019, according to a report.
After the merger, staff were given new contracts and badges.
Since its launch, two million users have signed up online.
Following the audit, a new budget was approved in March.
Over the past decade, forty stations have been added nationwide.
In response to demand, a second campus opened in the north.
Earlier this year, grants were awarded to ten local schools.
With new funding, more nurses will be hired next year.

notes: Both poles fire on 'the'; - top examples are business/institutional news, + top examples are narrative fiction. Broad pole; probe 0.13-0.24.
